title: Making Your Next Weapon
blurb: Each tier takes a part from the hunt, metal from the deep and light from the gates.

steps.hint: Bone, a family's horn, hide and one essence shard from the hunt.
Iron from the deep and a named beast's trophy. Hale's board has the first job.
Diamonds and a relic from a D-rank Lord. Hale's board has a job for the relic.
Deepglass and amethyst and parts from C-rank and B-rank Lords.
Netherite scrap and parts from B-rank and A-rank Lords or the deep guardians.
Starmetal from the fallen stars and parts from the Herald or the Court.

finish.line: You have walked the whole ladder.
